obligations.summary: The AI Office must monitor and supervise compliance of AI systems based on general-purpose AI models where both the model and system are developed by the same provider, exercising all powers of a market surveillance authority.

Market surveillance authorities must cooperate with the AI Office to carry out compliance evaluations and inform the Board and other market surveillance authorities when they have sufficient reason to consider general-purpose AI systems used for high-risk purposes to be non-compliant.

Where a market surveillance authority cannot access information related to a general-purpose AI model needed to conclude a high-risk AI system investigation, it may submit a reasoned request to the AI Office, which must supply the relevant information within 30 days.
exceptions: Market surveillance authority must have made all appropriate efforts to obtain the information before submitting the request to the AI Office.

obligations.summary: Market surveillance authorities must safeguard the confidentiality of information obtained during investigations in accordance with Article 78.
